front: Advantages of new technology for a business?
back: Higher productivity, lower cost per unit, consistent quality, speed, better information and customer service.

front: Disadvantages of new technology for a business?
back: High initial cost, training, breakdowns and power cuts, maintenance, becoming outdated, security risks.
Safer, less boring work and new skills; but job losses, retraining and insecurity.
